violations.text: Raw animal foods (such as raw meats) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as cooked rice) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. PIC relocated raw items. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/13/2026

The door to the outside, located in the front side door, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. PIC has part to fix door. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Per interview with PIC, chef is currently taking food safety manager course. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026
Establishment does not have documentation of parasite destruction letter for raw salmon for sushi. Per PIC, they are waiting for the letter from distributer. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

Raw animal foods (such as raw chicken) was observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as rice) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. PIC relocated raw chicken. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

Establishment has not submitted a request for approval to use time as a public health control for sushi rice. Establishment has started to use logs to track time. Inspector reviewed logs with PIC. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

The consumer advisory provided does not disclose the foods on the menu that are raw or undercooked. Per interview with PIC, they are waiting for the digital menu to be updated by 3rd party company. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026
Working containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. PIC labeled. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. 1) various items were observed cooling on the counter. PIC placed items in walk-in freezer for active cooling. 2) noodles were observed cooling in the walk-in cooler in containers deeper than 4 inches and covered. PIC placed in two shallower containers. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

The door to the outside, located in the front side, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026
Utensils were observed stored in stagnant water between uses. PIC removed and washed/sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quat sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026
The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine at the bar. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of equipment have an original packaging sticker film. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026
The door to the kitchen and dinning toilet rooms are not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

An employee was observed touching ready to eat food (bar fruit) with bare hands. Food employees must not touch exposed, ready-to-eat food with their bare hands and shall use suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, single use gloves, or dispensing equipment. PIC disposed of bar fruit. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

Dishes were observed in the hand-washing sinks at the bar and kitchen areas. Hand-washing sinks must not be blocked. Hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. PIC removed dishes from sinks. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026
Establishment does not have documentation of parasite destruction letter for sushi (salmon). New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

Raw animal foods (such as eggs and beef) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as produce) in the walk-in refrigerator and prep unit. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. PIC relocated raw items. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC disposed of ice. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

Chicharron, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. PIC disposed of item. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026
Establishment was not approved to use time as a public health control. PIC does not maintain required records. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026
The consumer advisory provided does not disclose the foods on the menu that are raw or undercooked. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

Inspector observed dehydrator with citrus. Per PIC, establishment dehydrates citrus to use as a garnish for beverages at the bar. PIC informed to stop dehydrating until they submit procedures to RIDOH-CFP AND get fruit lab tested for water activity. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods: - Various TCS items were observed cooling on the counter. PIC placed items in walk-in cooler for active cooling. - Chicharrons were observed cooling from the night before in a container greater than four inches deep with a temperature of 48F. PIC disposed of item. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

Salmon was observed thawing on the counter. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must be thawed in one of the following manners: 1) under refrigeration (41 degrees Fahrenheit or less); 2) completely submerged under running water; 3) as part of the cooking process; or 4) in the microwave if cooked immediately after thawing. PIC moved items to walk-in cooler. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

The establishment is lacking a thermometer to test food temperatures. Food temperature measuring devices shall be provided and be readily accessible for checking cooking, cooling, reheating, and hot/cold holding temperatures of time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026
Inspector observed insect control device (fly trap) above food prep area. PIC informed to move trap away from food prep/storage. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

The door to the outside, located in the front side, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026
Inspector observed single service items stored on the floor in the kitchen/storage areas. Single service items must be stored 6+ inches from the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

Foil, cardboard, and towels are used as shelf liners in kitchen area. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. PIC removed during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quat sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026
The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine at the bar. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: - Chest Freezer (Ice Accumulation) - Equipment (sticker/package material) New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026
The door to the toilet rooms are not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

The wall in the mop drying area is constructed of drywall. This material is not durable. Materials for wall surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

Wood is used in the construction of (storage shelves ) in the (bar) area. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. New Violation. Correct By: 02/14/2025
The non-food contact surfaces of the (prep sink and 3 bay sink ) have an accumulation of debris. New Violation. Correct By: 02/07/2025

The floors near hot water heater have a small accumulation of soil residue and/or droppings. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 02/07/2025
